report.method: Offline recorded-input simulation using shipping v5 rules; every attempt independently replay-verified. Trial rates describe controllers, not people. No game balance changes.

profiles.direct: 12 start delays, objective only, no attacks
profiles.reactive: 24 trials: 6 route/range policies × 4 start/tap seeds; 0.4–0.5 s decisions, ±0.12 world-unit tap error; visible nearest guard, no future simulation
profiles.slow: 24 trials: same policies/seeds, 0.7–0.8 s decisions, ±0.24 tap error
profiles.mild: 24 trials of a known winning command plan; per-command delay 0–0.067 s, initial delay 0–0.5 s, ±0.10 tap error; no replanning
profiles.coarse: 24 trials of a known winning command plan; per-command delay 0–0.20 s, initial delay 0–0.5 s, ±0.22 tap error; no replanning

levels.title: First Pickup
levels.briefing: Tap to move. Tap a robot to shoot. Take the Seeker and escape.

judgment.label: Intro
judgment.reason: The eight guided taps complete with full health. The simple controllers clear 47 of 48 runs. This is a suitable introduction.
judgment.experiment: Keep the current tutorial and combat strength. Check that a first-time player understands tapping a guard versus tapping the floor.

levels.title: Blind Corner
levels.briefing: Use cover to take the guards one at a time.

judgment.label: Forgiving
judgment.reason: The shooting controllers clear 34 of 48 runs. Direct rushing also succeeds in 8 of 12 starts. This still gives room to learn.
judgment.experiment: Keep the current balance. Do not add guards just because an experienced player can rush it.

levels.title: Crossfire
levels.briefing: Two firing lanes. Break one before crossing.

judgment.label: Sharp jump
judgment.reason: Shooting-controller clears fall to 11 of 48. The reference route loses 80 HP after pickup. Sentries cause 25 of the 37 controller deaths.
judgment.experiment: First experiment: delay the first reinforcement from 2.2 to 3.5 seconds. Leave damage and geometry alone for that comparison.

levels.title: Loading Lockdown
levels.briefing: Plan your return before the lockdown.

judgment.label: Route-sensitive
judgment.reason: Only 1 of 48 shooting-controller runs succeeds, despite an 80 HP reference clear. Forty of the 47 deaths occur in the upper third. Route knowledge matters much more here.
judgment.experiment: First experiment: turn one upper sentry patrol away from the approach to the phone, so both firing lanes do not cover the crossing together.

levels.title: Skybridge
levels.briefing: Move between shots across the roof.

judgment.label: Early spike
judgment.reason: No shooting-controller or perturbed-plan trial succeeds. The reference clear has only 10 HP left and takes all 90 damage after pickup.
judgment.experiment: First experiment: move the two reinforcement arrivals from 2.2/4.4 to 4/7 seconds. Keep the roof layout, guard health and movement unchanged.

levels.title: Heavy Watch
levels.briefing: Go around the Heavy instead of trading hits.

judgment.label: Hard
judgment.reason: Three of 48 shooting-controller runs succeed. Scouts cause 29 of 45 deaths; the Heavy causes 14. The Heavy alone is not the main problem.
judgment.experiment: First experiment: move one scout patrol away from the Heavy courtyard crossing. Keep the Heavy as the lesson instead of weakening every enemy.

levels.title: Split Route
levels.briefing: Choose the safe route or risk the shorter lane.

judgment.label: Escape spike
judgment.reason: No shooting-controller trial succeeds. All 48 deaths occur in the upper third, and 40 happen after pickup. The reference loses 75 HP on escape.
judgment.experiment: First experiment: delay the first reinforcement sentry from 2.2 to 4 seconds. Recheck whether the player can leave the phone bay before the lanes close.

levels.title: Twin Relay
levels.briefing: Bring both phones back. Your health must last.

judgment.label: Endurance
judgment.reason: Four of 48 shooting-controller runs succeed. Forty-three of the 44 deaths happen after the first pickup. This requires two deliveries without a health reset.
judgment.experiment: First experiment: remove the second reinforcement scout. Keep the two-phone objective; it is already a distinct increase in workload.

levels.title: Dark Circuit
levels.briefing: Tap the switch to open the vault gate.

judgment.label: Knowledge-heavy
judgment.reason: The reference clears untouched, and 7 of 24 mildly delayed plans still work. But neither shooting controller clears it; most deaths occur in the middle and before pickup.
judgment.experiment: First experiment: turn the sentry watching the switch corridor away at the start. Keep the sealed gate and switch sequence intact.

levels.title: Vault Window
levels.briefing: The exit opens for three seconds. Watch its light.

judgment.label: Crossfire + timing
judgment.reason: No shooting-controller trial succeeds. Thirty of their 48 deaths happen before pickup. The reference waits only 0.73 seconds at the closed exit, so the timer is not the only issue.
judgment.experiment: First experiment: offset one upper sentry patrol from the Heavy firing lane. Do not increase the mission timer to solve an approach problem. Review the 3-second exit window separately with people.

levels.title: Security Grid
levels.briefing: Break the crossfire before taking the phone.

judgment.label: Late spike
judgment.reason: No shooting-controller or perturbed-plan trial succeeds. Thirty-four of the 48 controller deaths happen before pickup; 31 occur in the middle third.
judgment.experiment: First experiment: stagger the two middle sentry patrols so their aim windows do not overlap on the same crossing. Keep the four alarm reserves for this first comparison.

levels.title: Last Seeker
levels.briefing: Disable the Warden or find a way past. Then get out.

judgment.label: Finale, harsh entry
judgment.reason: The reference wins with 15 HP. Every shooting-controller trial dies before pickup; the Heavy causes 26 of 48 deaths. The opening is killing runs before the Warden becomes the focus.
judgment.experiment: First experiment: move the lower Heavy patrol one crossing farther up. Preserve the Warden and final escape pressure, then retest the opening.

campaign.note: Progress model round-trip in memory; not browser localStorage, live account, payment or device persistence.
